instruction: I want to allow websites to track my activity. Please disable the 'Do Not Track' feature in Chrome.

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt install jq -y

mkdir -p /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default && if [ ! -f /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default/Preferences ]; then echo '{}' > /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default/Preferences; fi && cd /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default && jq '. + {"safebrowsing":{"enabled":false,"enhanced":false}}' Preferences > temp && mv temp Preferences

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling Do Not Track in Chrome. Uses same getter as variation 2 but expects 'false' value.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads the 'enable_do_not_track' field from Chrome's Preferences file
Expected value 'false' correctly represents disabled Do Not Track (matching instruction requirement)
Exact match metric is appropriate for verifying boolean setting state
Postconfig properly restarts Chrome to ensure Preferences file is saved and reloaded
Complete instruction coverage - evaluator checks exactly the required setting
Getter handles multiple OS platforms and includes error handling for missing files/fields
Data flow is correct: getter returns string 'true'/'false', metric compares against expected string 'false'
